sentences.text: first information statement of Sri. Manosundar Vedivel.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 and 2 borrowed a personal loan of Rs. 15,09,083/- on 16-06-2008.
Thereafter they defaulted in repayment of the loan amount and the total outstanding balance as on 20-10-2014 was Rs. 43,97,770/-.

When the bank officials went to the address provided by them they came to know that the accused had criminally conspired to cheat the bank and had closed the office and house and fled away without paying the loan amount.
Later they came to know about the whereabouts of the accused.

Later when CW1 to 3 went to the house of the Accused No.1 and 2 and asked to repay the outstanding amount, the accused No.1 had abused CW2 in filthy language and also threatened him with dire consequences.

Later the complainant bank filed a PCR before this court in PCR No.
16870/2014 and this court had referred this case for further investigation U/Sec.1556(3) of Cr.P.c
Based on the said  3  C.C.No.15228/2015 information, a case in Cr.No.08/2015 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of C.K.Acchukattu P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused No.1 entered appearance and was enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
During the trial of the case, the Accused No.2 remained absconding, this court had ordered for filing of splitup chargesheet against the Accused No.2.
In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 to PW-3 and got marked Ex.P.1 to P.3 documents.

The Statement of Accused No.1 as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C.,
was recorded.
The accused denied the incriminating circumstances appearing against him.
The accused No.1 has not let in any oral or documentary evidence on their behalf.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the Accused No.1 and 2 borrowed a personal  loan of Rs. 15,09,083/- on 16-06-2008 and when the  bank officials went to the address provided by them they  came to know that the accused had criminally conspired  to cheat the bank and had closed the office and fled  away without paying the loan amount and later when  CW1 to 3 went to the house of the Accused No.1 and 2  and asked to repay the outstanding amount, the  accused No.1 had abused CW2 in filthy language and  also threatened him with dire consequences and  thereby accused have committed the offences punishable

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.15228/2015  REASONS  9.
POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined three witnesses as PW-1 to PW-3 got marked Ex.P.1 to Ex.P3 documents.

Ex.P.1 is the complaint,
Ex-P2 is the FIR and Ex-P3 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-2 was examined as PW-1.
He in his examination-in- chief has deposed that the accused had availed a loan of Rs. 15 lakhs from the complainant bank.
After availing the loan they have not paid the amount and they have vacated the office in the address given by them.
Later he came to know that the Accused are residing at Tumkuru.
So he went to the address of the accused and demanded to repay the amount.
At that time the accused threatened him to kill by crushing him with the car.
He has deposed that he had given statement to the police.
During his cross examination he has deposed that he provided services to various banks.
He admits that he had not stated the date of incident in his statement.
He deposes that accused abused him in their office.
6  C.C.No.15228/2015 Manosundar Vadivel.

M vs Bhadra Aradya G on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168050107/
4  11. CW-6 was examined as PW-2.
He has deposed regarding receiving the complaint, registering of the FIR and conducting of spot panchanama..
12. CW-3 was examined as PW-3.
He in his examination-in- chief has deposed that the accused had availed a loan of Rs. 15 lakhs from the complainant bank.
After availing the loan they have not paid the amount and they have vacated the office and the house in the address given by them.
Later they came to know that the Accused are residing at Tumkuru.
So CW2 went to the house of the accused and demanded to repay the amount.
At that time the accused threatened him to kill by crushing him with the car.
He has deposed that he came to know of the incident from PW1.

He has deposed that he had given statement to the police.
 13.

On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that there is no material is produced by the prosecution to show that the accused had availed loan and they have criminally conspired to defraud the complainant bank and vacated the house and office without intimating the bank.

In the absence of any materials to show that the accused had indeed availed the loan this  7  C.C.No.15228/2015 court cannot come to a conclusion that the accused had defaulted in loan with an intention to cheat the complainant bank.
Similarly in the absence of any loan documents this court also holds that the charge of criminal conspiracy between the accused No.1 and 2 to defraud the bank also remains not proved.

sentences.text: Now coming to the aspect of abusing the CW2 in filthy language and giving him life threat is concerned, other than the evidence of PW1 there is no other evidence to prove the same.
PW3 only states that he came to know about the incident through PW1.
This amounts to PW3 only being a hearsay witness.
As PW3 is not an eye-witness, his evidence cannot be considered.
It is also interesting to note that the PW1 had never given complaint to the jurisdictional police at Tumakuru of the alleged incident when the incident occurred.
Infact in the chief examination and also in the complaint the date of alleged incident is not mentioned.
In the complaint it is only mentioned that the accused are threatening the bank official from recovering the dues.
Such being the case the alleged incident itself is in doubt.
Hence, this court gives benefit of doubt to the accused No.1 and holds that the prosecution has failed to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
8  C.C.No.15228/2015  Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
15. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 420, 504, 506, 120(B) of I.P.C
The bail bonds of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
As case against Accused No.2 is split up, office is hereby directed to preserve the records and property, if any for future reference.
